answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network routes identity validation through an economic prism where each new agent must commit an immutable cryptographic stake. Each registration burns capital under a superlinear cost function C(k) = B · k^1.8, carving an insurmountable financial canyon between authentic participants and malicious identity spammers. By rendering counterfeit personas a valueless relic via irreversible stake burning, attacker costs scale exponentially against marginal returns.
